name: Bob Su Rotaia
editorial: Eight updated descriptions, official winter 2026/27 per-person and group fares, transport regulation age conditions and operator length (830 m downhill plus 270 m lift). Existing 662 m length corrected to 1100 m total.
pricing: Operator winter 2026/27 page: €5 per person, €4 per person for groups of at least twenty; FVGcard 50% discount with conditions; Family Pass 20% on up to eight rides. Summer 2026 page lists same base fares.
hours: Operator winter 2026/27 page states 10:00–16:00 on operating days, with actual dates available only in live infoneve. Summer 2026 operation ended 13 September. No exact winter opening date inferred.
